s.note: Jenna's pie for the morning she finds out
s.how: Line a 24-hole mini muffin tin with rounds from 2 sheets shortcrust and blind-bake. Fill with 100g diced brie and 80g chopped ham. Whisk 2 eggs with 150ml cream and chives, pour in and bake at 170C for 15 minutes.

s.note: the early shift at the pie diner
s.how: Rub 100g butter into 300g flour with 3 tsp baking powder and stir in 250ml buttermilk. Cut rounds and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Brown 300g sausage mince, stir in 2 tbsp flour and 400ml milk and simmer with lots of pepper. Pour over the split biscuits.

m.note: a pie for dinner, not just dessert
m.how: Brown 800g diced chicken thighs, add a diced onion, 2 carrots and 2 celery sticks with thyme. Stir in 2 tbsp flour, 250ml stock and 200ml cream and simmer until thick, then add 150g peas. Cover with puff pastry, egg wash and bake at 200C for 30 minutes.

w.how: Press 200g crushed biscuits with 80g melted butter into a pie tin. Melt 250g caramels with 3 tbsp cream and pour in. Pour over 200g dark chocolate melted with 150ml cream and set. Drizzle more caramel and flaky salt on top.

d.note: the coffee at the pie diner counter
d.how: Brew 400ml strong coffee and chill. Blend with 8 scoops vanilla ice cream, 200ml cold milk and 4 tbsp thick caramel with a pinch of salt until smooth. Pour into four tall glasses, top with whipped cream, a drizzle of caramel and a few crumbled shortbread biscuits.
